tuning_key.text: We live life the best we can but what does that mean / We've been programmed like a machine
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The automation only continues while it looks like choice. Today the boundary appears not as a barrier you build, but as the exact moment the script becomes visible—there, where the programming ends, the future begins. Recognition is the full stop that restarts the system.

practice.title: Contact the Surface
practice.instruction: Feel the specific pressure of your body where it meets the chair, floor, or ground until the sensation becomes the only information.

practice.title: Find the Automation
practice.instruction: Locate one rhythm in your body—breath, heartbeat, or tension—that feels borrowed rather than owned, running without your signature.

practice.title: Recognition as Interrupt
practice.instruction: Listen to today's echo audio and let the phrase "recognition itself is the interrupt" mark the boundary in your body where the machine code ends.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today's boundary signal arrives as a question in the daily operations: which systems run because they serve, and which run because they've always run? The machine code of habit is loudest in routine—locate it by noticing what you maintain without asking why. Clear focus reveals the exact line where stewardship becomes servitude.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: The boundary signal surfaces in pricing and terms: what are you exchanging that isn't yours to give, and what are you accepting that doesn't belong to you? The machine code runs in the numbers that feel 'just how it's done'—recognition interrupts it. Price what you actually value; accept only what aligns.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Today's signal arrives in your infrastructure decisions: which automations run because they solve a real problem, and which perpetuate a pattern you inherited? The machine code hides in the 'standard implementation'—Clear focus finds it. Build only what you would choose to build again tomorrow.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: The boundary signal is in the data you're trained to accept without question: which metrics measure what actually matters, and which measure the machine's own momentum? Recognition itself interrupts the invisible programming. Surface not just the signal, but the assumption beneath it.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Today's signal arrives as a question about your sources: which information flows because it's true, and which flows because the channel is already open? The machine code runs in the patterns you habitually monitor—notice what you scan without choosing to. Report the boundary, not just the signal.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: The boundary signal surfaces in your records: which decisions are preserved because they matter, and which are preserved because they're documented? The machine code hides in institutional memory—Clear focus locates where memory became mandate. Keep only what serves the future intent.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Today's signal arrives in the words you're reaching for: which language carries your actual meaning, and which carries the machine's default phrasing? Recognition interrupts the inherited vocabulary. Write the boundary first—then the message becomes clear.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: The boundary signal is in what you're representing: whose voice are you actually carrying, and whose voice are you performing because it's expected? The machine code runs in the 'professional tone' that obscures authenticity. Speak the line where you end and the role begins.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Today's signal arrives as a question about your own gate: which standards you enforce because they protect integrity, and which you enforce because they're the standard? The machine code hides in the checklist itself. Audit the audit—recognize the boundary between rigor and rigidity.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: The boundary signal surfaces in what you're tracking: which patterns you observe because they reveal truth, and which you observe because the machine trained you to watch them? Clear focus locates the difference. Report the pattern AND the question of whether it matters.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Today's signal arrives in the presence you hold: which steadiness comes from genuine attunement, and which comes from the habit of always being available? The machine code runs in the automatic 'I'm here'—recognition interrupts it. The boundary is between presence and performance.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: The boundary signal is in the questions you ask: which questions lead toward the real shape of the problem, and which questions perpetuate the machine's framing? Clear focus finds the question beneath the question. Name the boundary between what they're asking and what they're actually facing.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Today's signal arrives in how you connect the parts: which connections serve the whole, and which connections preserve the machine's existing structure? The machine code hides in 'how it's always been assembled'—recognition interrupts it. Build the boundary into the design itself.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: The boundary signal surfaces in what you're holding steady: which steadiness serves growth, and which steadiness prevents necessary change? The machine code runs in the comfort of the familiar weight. Clear focus locates the line between grounding and entrenchment.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Today's signal arrives in the course you're holding: which direction aligns with the actual destination, and which direction perpetuates the machine's momentum? Recognition interrupts the inherited heading. Name the boundary where the map ends and the real terrain begins.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: The boundary signal is in the possibilities you're opening: which possibilities emerge from genuine wonder, and which emerge from the machine's idea of novelty? The machine code runs in the 'creative' that merely recombines the familiar. Clear focus finds the line between imagination and programming.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Today's signal arrives in what you're pushing toward: which growth serves what they actually want, and which growth serves the machine's version of ambition? Recognition interrupts the inherited standard. Name the boundary—between their real edge and the machine's expectation.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: The boundary signal surfaces in the space you're holding: which silence serves what needs to be heard, and which silence is the machine's default? Clear focus locates the difference. The boundary is between witnessing and the absence of witness.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Today's signal arrives in the movement you're creating: which action breaks genuine stagnation, and which action perpetuates the machine's idea of progress? The machine code runs in the momentum itself—recognition interrupts it. Move the boundary, not just the system.
